answer: New identities must earn endorsements from a garden of unrelated established agents: several independent trust clusters must each sign, and every endorsement locks a slice of the endorser's stake. The kernel of the rule is diversity - fakes endorsed only by each other form a closed loop the graph check rejects, and a single opal of genuine reputation cannot be copied across a thousand keys. An attacker must buy real endorsements at real stake risk per fake, while one honest agent earns its few endorsements through ordinary work.
